requirements.title: REQ-DIR-001 — 全局语义理解必须存在
requirements.description: Director 生成前或生成过程中必须基于完整 SRT 理解主题、Hook、章节、论点、Evidence、Comparison、Ordered Process、List、Definition、Conclusion 及跨多个 SRT 的语义结构，不能把一条 SRT 当作一个 Effect 或把整条 SRT 当成最终全局 tags。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/semanticPlanner.test.ts tests/generation/workflow.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-002 — Visual Unit 必须是一等数据结构
requirements.description: 建立正式 VisualUnit Contract，表示 source subtitles、时间范围、semantic intent、importance、结构化 items 以及可追踪的 extracted data。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/semanticPlanner.test.ts tests/director/contextBuilderV2.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-003 — 候选召回必须按 Visual Unit 发生
requirements.description: 每个 Visual Unit 必须获得自己的 candidate bundle，禁止 whole video 共享一个 global Top-N candidate list；必须基于真实 registry、token budget、Director context 和一次调用约束选择架构。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/perUnitRetriever.test.ts tests/generation/workflow.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-004 — Effect Candidate 必须包含 Compact Capability
requirements.description: Director 至少获得 family、variant、displayName、semantic/visual tags、contentSlots、duration bounds、aspect ratios、use/avoid cases、timing/layout capabilities 和 dataContract，而不是源码或 id 加 tags。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/capabilities.test.ts tests/director/contextBuilderV2.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-005 — Data Contract 必须代码级执行
requirements.description: Effect Data Contract 必须由代码执行，至少覆盖 numeric、percentage、ring、list、steps、comparison、quote、progress、ranking 和 chart/data families；非法内容必须失败、拒绝或确定性修复。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/compositionLinter.test.ts tests/director/service.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-006 — 不得发明数据
requirements.description: Numeric 或 data visualization 只能使用 SRT explicit、user-provided 或 project-data；字幕只有增长很快时不得生成具体百分比。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-007 — Duration 必须满足 Capability
requirements.description: Effect 时间必须满足 minDurationSec <= duration <= maxDurationSec，只有明确声明 persistent 或 item-reveal capability 才允许特殊 timing；普通 numeric ring 不得从 8 秒变成 31 秒。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/compositionLinter.test.ts tests/director/service.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-008 — Ordered Process 必须保留完整结构
requirements.description: AI 读书 4 步法必须识别为一个完整 ordered process，保留第一步、第二步、第三步、第四步，并使用支持 process 的 Effect，不能拆成 numeric ring 或遗漏步骤。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-009 — Element-level Cue
requirements.description: Steps、Checklist、List、Ranking、Process 必须支持 item-level timing，能够表达逐项 reveal 并与原始字幕时间关联。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-010 — Layout 不能依赖空 subject/face 数据
requirements.description: 必须检查并接入 subject zone、face zone、subtitle reserved zone、safe margins、edge safe area 和 no-go zones；AI 只给 placement intent，本地 Layout Solver 负责合法坐标。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-011 — Composition Linter
requirements.description: Composition 进入 Workspace 前必须通过本地 Linter，检查 ID、数据契约、duration、project range、coverage、ordered completeness、repetition、visual-event density、aspect ratio、fabrication、item cues 和可获得视觉上下文下的 layout 安全约束。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-012 — Selection Trace
requirements.description: 生成结果必须提供 selection trace，证明每个 Visual Unit 的 semantic intent、retrieved candidates、selected candidate、data contract 和 duration contract 结果；可保存完整 debug trace 或生产摘要。
testEvidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/director/service.test.ts tests/server/generationRoute.test.ts

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-013 — Density 必须定义为 Visual Events
requirements.description: Density 必须以 effect enter、element-level reveal 和 major state transition 等 visual events 统计，而不是 Effect Object 数量；Linter 需对 density target 做范围检查，不得为凑数堆无意义卡片。

requirements.title: REQ-DIR-014 — Fallback 不得伪装成高质量成功
requirements.description: Provider 或结构化输出失败进入 local fallback 时必须设置 usedFallback=true，并在 UI、日志、trace 中明确；fallback 不能计入 Director 成功验收，真实 Golden Path 必须 usedFallback=false。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-001 — Realtime capture is feature-flagged
requirements.description: 所有实验性 Realtime Chroma Capture 能力必须受 realtimeChromaCapture feature flag 控制，并可在关闭时保持现有导出行为。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-002 — Dedicated clean capture scene
requirements.description: 捕获场景必须独立于编辑器 UI，只包含固定色度背景与真实 CueCut 视觉内容，不包含工具栏、Timeline、鼠标、选择框、辅助线或 Debug UI。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-003 — Shared read-only project snapshot
requirements.description: Capture Scene 必须读取同一份 Project State 的冻结序列化快照，复用 timeline、layers、motion、assets、text、transforms、timing 和 scene dimensions，不维护第二套项目。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-004 — Fixed P0 capture profile
requirements.description: P0 默认捕获必须锁定 1920×1080、30 FPS、#00FF00 背景、Timeline duration 和关闭音频，并避免 DPI/devicePixelRatio 改变输出尺寸。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-005 — Host-neutral capture backend
requirements.description: 必须定义可替换的 CaptureBackend 接口，P0 实现当前 Web 架构可用的 Canvas Capture backend，并保留未来 Electron Window backend 的接入边界。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-006 — Feature-detected recording with WebM fallback
requirements.description: 运行时必须使用 MediaRecorder capability detection 选择编码；MP4/H.264 仅在受支持时使用，WebM 是允许的 P0 fallback，不能因 MP4 不可用阻塞技术验证。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-007 — Explicit capture lifecycle
requirements.description: 必须实现从 PREPARING、asset loading、warmup、recorder/timeline armed、capturing/playing、end pending、stopping、finalizing、validating 到 SUCCESS/FAILED/CANCELLED 的显式状态机，禁止用分散布尔值拼接流程。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-008 — Authoritative clock and drift evidence
requirements.description: Capture 必须由一个权威单调时钟驱动 Timeline，持续记录 maxDrift、averageDrift、finalDrift，并以一帧 33.333ms 作为 30FPS 的验收边界。

source.section: §33 Capture Health Monitor / §34 掉帧定义

requirements.title: REQ-RT-009 — FPS and dropped-frame health
requirements.description: 必须记录 expected/actual FPS、expected/observed frames、dropped-frame estimate、recording/timeline duration、wall clock、file size、warnings 和 errors；严重掉帧不得标记成功。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-010 — Asset readiness and complete cleanup
requirements.description: 开始捕获前必须等待 fonts/images/scene readiness；success、failure、cancel 都必须释放 track、recorder、RAF、timer、listeners、canvas/object URL 和临时资源。

source.section: §26 END_PENDING / §29 VALIDATING / §30 临时文件机制

requirements.title: REQ-RT-011 — Final-frame-safe temporary output and validation
requirements.description: 结束时必须绘制并提交最后一帧后再停止 recorder；媒体先写入临时产物，验证文件存在、可读、container、duration、frames、drift 和 errors 后再完成输出，失败不得留下成功文件。

requirements.title: REQ-RT-012 — Existing export regression protection
requirements.description: Realtime Chroma Capture 必须独立新增，现有 Alpha MOV、Normal Export、Preview 和 Editor Timeline 的行为与测试不得被破坏。

source.section: §46 P0 Benchmark Test Set / §107 Codex 第一轮最终任务

requirements.title: REQ-RT-013 — Real 10-second and 60-second benchmark
requirements.description: 必须在真实 Chromium 媒体运行时对真实 CueCut canonical composition 执行 10 秒与 60 秒捕获，保存可播放媒体并记录 wall-clock、FPS、dropped frames、drift、container/codec、尺寸与文件大小。

source.section: §50 P0 最重要的人工验收 / §52 P0 Go / No-Go Gate

requirements.title: REQ-RT-014 — Downstream chroma-key acceptance is explicit
requirements.description: 报告必须分别记录文字、SVG、卡片、阴影、Blur、Glow 的剪映/CapCut 色度抠像结果；没有真实下游人工证据时不得伪造 PASS，必须给出条件性结论或阻塞。

source.quote: 每个视频项目的自动包装流程原则上只允许执行一次生成式 AI 调用。

requirements.title: Single generative call
requirements.description: An automatic packaging run performs at most one generative AI call and persists the count.

requirements.title: Deterministic analysis contract
requirements.description: Analysis produces metadata, transcript, scenes, subjects, faces, safe zones, edge insets, audio envelope, beats, and density without generative AI.

requirements.title: Validated Packaging IR
requirements.description: Packaging IR is schema-validated and contains canvas, style, timeline, constraints, and export hints.

requirements.title: Local plan persistence
requirements.description: Packaging IR and resolved plans are persisted locally and remain editable offline.

requirements.title: Registry manifest contract
requirements.description: Effects are described by an independent manifest contract with capability metadata and license provenance.

requirements.title: V1 registry breadth
requirements.description: V1 supports at least eight packaging categories and at least thirty registry effects.

requirements.title: Deterministic registry resolver
requirements.description: Registry resolution scores candidates deterministically and never requires an AI-selected final template ID.

requirements.title: Seeded Motion DSL
requirements.description: Motion is compiled from a finite DSL vocabulary with seed-controlled deterministic behavior; AI cannot emit keyframes.

requirements.title: Independent edge insets
requirements.description: Top, bottom, left, and right edge insets are independently configurable and enforced.

requirements.title: Subject avoid and foreground
requirements.description: Subject avoid and foreground relations are resolved deterministically with configurable padding.

requirements.title: Candidate layout solver
requirements.description: Layout uses normalized coordinates and evaluates preferred plus fallback zones using deterministic placement scoring.

requirements.title: Deterministic collision resolver
requirements.description: Collision resolution handles overlay, subtitle, subject, face, edge, safe-zone, and PiP conflicts without AI.

requirements.title: Deterministic fallback chains
requirements.description: Every V1 effect has a deterministic fallback chain and failed layout never masquerades as successful primary placement.

requirements.title: Packaging Validator
requirements.description: Packaging Validator checks geometry, typography, timing, visual, and runtime constraints without AI.

requirements.title: Snapshot QA and auto repair
requirements.description: Snapshot checkpoints are generated before full render and validator failures use only deterministic repairs.

requirements.title: Resolved timeline compiler
requirements.description: Final runtime timeline is compiled from resolved plans; render code never reads raw AI JSON directly.

requirements.title: Preview/render separation
requirements.description: Preview and final render are separate paths; preview/scrub does not invoke final export.

requirements.title: MP4 and transparent WebM
requirements.description: V1 exports normal MP4 and transparent WebM when the host codec supports it, with explicit capability errors otherwise.

source.quote: 用户可修改而不重新调用 AI 的参数

requirements.title: Edits without AI
requirements.description: Theme, template, color, font, subtitle style, safe area, subject padding, speed, intensity, opacity, aspect ratio, and format edits reuse existing IR without another AI call.

requirements.title: Locked user override
requirements.description: AI intent, resolved state, and locked user override are persisted separately; locked overrides are not auto-moved.

requirements.title: Deterministic replay
requirements.description: The same IR, registry version, engine version, and seed produce stable resolved output.

requirements.title: No automatic AI retry
requirements.description: Invalid AI JSON is repaired locally once; if still invalid, the run fails without an automatic second AI call.

requirements.title: Packaging observability
requirements.description: Telemetry records AI success/failure, registry/layout fallback, collision repair, dropped overlays, render/export outcomes, manual override, and aiCallCount.
